defs.def: opposing or disagreeing with sb/sth 反对；与 … 相反；逆；违反

ex.s: Not standing a chance against competitive applicants, I came out of the interview with an upset look.
ex.t: 社会互动是理解符号的关键。

ex.s: Due to the lack of scientific proof concerning their impacts, no one has succeeded in winning a lawsuit against cloud-seeding companies.
ex.t: 为了美术O-level考试，我需要交一幅油画作品。

ex.s: Perhaps she had been struggling against the window too long and was too tired?
ex.t: 也许她在窗户边挣扎太久，累坏了？

ex.s: In a world where nearly 800 million people a year go hungry, “food waste goes against the moral grain,” as Elizabeth Royte writes in this month’s cover story.
ex.t: 在一个每年有近8亿人口挨饿的世界里，"食物浪费违背道德准则"，正如Elizabeth Royte在本月封面故事中所写的那样。

ex.s: Discrimination against female scientists.

ex.s: It's a race against time.
ex.t: 这是一场与时间的赛跑。

ex.s: The elephant was found to either use suction at a fixed distance from the pancake to "raise” the object in the air and hold it, or gently press the tip of its trunk against the pancake and apply suction to pick it up.
ex.t: 研究人员发现大象要么在固定距离用吸力将薄饼"抬"到空中并保持住，要么轻轻地将鼻尖抵在薄饼上然后施加吸力将其捡起。

ex.s: fight back against others’ criticisms
ex.t: 反击他人的批评

ex.s: Less discrimination against women.
ex.t: 人们社会地位的变化。

ex.s: Baggy has become the first dog in the UK—and potentially the world—to join the fight against air pollution by recording pollutant levels near the ground.
ex.t: 它的监测器显示，越接近地面，空气污染程度越高，这突显了一个令人担忧的问题：婴儿和幼儿患肺部疾病的风险可能更高。

ex.s: Instead, I agree with Oxford University philosopher Nick Bostrom, who believes that the heaviest risks from A GI do not come from a decision to turn against mankind but rather from a dogged pursuit of set objectives at the expense of everything else.
ex.t: 相反，我同意牛津大学哲学家尼克·波斯特罗姆的观点，他认为AGI的最大风险并非来自决定背叛人类，而是来自对既定目标的执着追求而不顾其他一切。

ex.s: For legal ___44___, most restaurants have a policy against ___45___ food waste.
ex.t: 只有大约十分之一的地方会给他提供本将被丢弃的食物。

ex.s: Would you BET on the future of this man？ He is 53 years old． Most of his adult life has been a losing struggle against debt and misfortune． A war injury has made his left hand stop functioning， and he has often been in prison． Driven by heaven﹣knows﹣what motives， he determines to write a book．
ex.t: （5）预警系统如何帮助我们维持生态平衡？

ex.s: C．misery inspires a man to fight against his fate
ex.t: 实际上，我们大多数人都在逐步缩小生活的多样性。我们在自己的专业领域取得成功，然后被困在其中。没有什么能让我们感到惊讶。我们失去了好奇心。但是，如果我们愿意学习，机会无处不在。

ex.s: It was a tradition for the school's old team to play against the（4）     team at the end of spring practice． The old team had no coach， and they didn't even practice to（5）     the game． Being the coach of the new team， I was excited because I knew we were going to win， but to my disappointment we were defeated． I couldn't （6）     I had got into such a situation． Thinking hard about it， I came to（7）     that my team might not be the number one team in Georgia， but they were（8）     me． I had to change my （9）     about their ability and potential．
ex.t: 从这次经历中我学到了很多关于领导者的态度如何影响团队成员的道理。我不把他们视为失败者，而是推动和鼓励他们。我帮助他们正确看待自己，他们把自己塑造成了赢家。

ex.s: When I started running in my 30s, I realized running was a battle against myself, not about competition or whether or not I was athletic.
ex.t: 她从不介意凌晨4点的闹钟声，也从不过问我在跑步上的开销。

ex.s: It was all about the battle against my own body and mind.
ex.t: 我是最后一批完成比赛的跑步者之一。

ex.s: If we are not careful, then, we could face a kind of global chess match against very determined, super intelligent machines whose objectives conflict with our own, with the real world as the chessboard.
ex.t: 还有一些人认为超级AI永远不会出现。

ex.s: Unfortunately, that plan seems unlikely to work: we have yet to invent a firewall that is secure against ordinary humans, let alone super intelligent machines.
ex.t: 指挥杀手机器人军队D. 比数学家计算得更快

ex.s: be secure against evil human beings
ex.t: 当实验室老鼠不被允许睡觉时，它们在一个月内就会死亡。

defs.def: not to the advantage or favour of sb/sth 对 … 不利

ex.s: Speakers will state whether they are for or against the statement.
ex.t: 发言者将说明他们是赞成还是反对该声明。

ex.s: It lists your performance against other runners in your social network.
ex.t: 它列出了您在社交网络中与其他跑步者的表现。

ex.s: With this in mind, perhaps we should judge a movie in its own right, and not against its original source.
ex.t: 考虑到这一点，也许我们应该独立判断一部电影，而不是根据其原始来源。

ex.s: Before the contest, he competed against a girl at school.
ex.t: 比赛前，他在学校里和一个女孩比赛。

defs.def: close to, touching or hitting sb/sth 紧靠；倚；碰；撞

ex.s: At last, showing a strong will and the steeliest nerves, they played a close match against Serbia to seize gold in the final.
ex.t: 最后，他们表现出强烈的意志和最坚定的神经，与塞尔维亚队进行了近距离比赛，在决赛中夺取了金牌。

defs.def: in order to prevent sth from happening or to reduce the damage caused by sth 以防
with sth in the background, as a contrast 以 … 为背景；衬托
